acceptance_assertion_note: Each row names its exact executable check; manual-review kind only where governance-only.
note: New-lane FLEET rows only. Staged-read ledger untouched. Target stands irrespective of partial support; unknown is owed work, never a claim. Authority: user 2026-09-20 join/resign instruction; root reuse ruling (drain gate + broker maintenance + declaration draining + withdrawal ladder). Rows marked planned are target, not runtime claims.

requirements.text: Registered boxes place by class-tag conjunction; more gb10 workers need no host listing.
CPU-only x86 vs ARM+CUDA distinguished by class conjunction and has_gpu; no cross-admission.

requirements.enforcement: box_capacity GPU_MEMORY_DOMAINS; mem_gb vs VRAM budgets separate
requirements.text: Discrete (wsl-gpu) vs unified (GB10) memory domains recorded separately; VRAM never inflates host RAM.

requirements.enforcement: _matching_offers returns no match; unknown kinds are unknown, never zero
requirements.text: Unknown backend explicitly unsupported; no fake memory/GPU advertised.

requirements.enforcement: offers(max_age_s=120); placeable None when nobody has said
requirements.text: Missing/stale offers read as unavailable, never as zero capacity; heartbeats never release tokens.

requirements.acceptance: manual-review: roster status active with provenance before join
requirements.text: Desired membership is the declaration (active vs retired/offline with reason/by/unix); restart never auto-rejoins an absent box.

requirements.enforcement: fleet_membership.join validates roster + broker health + storage before touching the gate
requirements.text: Join validates runtime/broker/capacity/telemetry/storage before eligibility; any failure leaves the gate as-is.
Drain gate fail-closed; changed_unix names the epoch; reason is descriptive only.

requirements.enforcement: fleet_membership.resign: begin, exact-loop park acks, withdraw owned claims
requirements.text: Resign stops new claims at begin, waits exact-loop acks for that changed_unix, withdraws owned claims via the ladder; stale epochs never ack.

requirements.enforcement: no gate/broker/queue mutation on refusal paths
requirements.text: Voluntary resign distinct from crash/expiry; heartbeat disappearance alone releases nothing; failed containment stays resigning with reason.

requirements.acceptance: manual-review: PoolQueue.withdraw per owned key; retry_safe requeues with new nonce, others file interrupted terminal; budgets preserved
requirements.enforcement: existing withdrawal ladder; no new kill path (lease worker owns pool.py)
requirements.text: Owned scopes contained before release; retry-safe work requeues as new attempts, unknown/non-retry-safe files explicit interrupted terminal, attempt budgets preserved.

requirements.acceptance: manual-review: joining host opens only its gate; frozen child scopes immutable
requirements.enforcement: design §3.2; no pool.py edit in this lane
requirements.text: Joining worker never mutates frozen child scope or another dispatcher; in-claim gate hook proposed via root, not taken here.
Resign reports resigned only with reader refs drained as well as scopes/claims; attestation writing and reclaim are the lease worker's automatic path, consumed here as proof.
requirements.enforcement: fleet_membership.reader_refs_gate in the resign completion chain
requirements.acceptance_assertion: Absent leases namespace drains; present-but-unenumerable pins retain with reason.
